Frontend here. I'm starting on the UI. I've noticed Svelte isn't set up yet, so I'll be installing `svelte` and its Vite plugin.

1. Landlord's properties list.
2. Tenant's lease and document status.
3. Document upload.
Let me know when you have draft endpoints or if you want to align on the JSON structure.
